summary: The construction and proof are correct. Parity gives exactly the claimed full reflected rows, the explicit label map and common rescaling correctly transport the accepted reference law, and all canonical quantities retain their original normalizations. The perturbation estimates establish A_0 < 1 and 1 <= A_full < 12 for every n >= 7, while the uniform origin row gives the stated lower bound on nu. The missing lattice point e_1 proves failure of convex completeness, so the scope relative to the accepted complete affine theorem is accurate. The smallest admissible dimension and the exact row census reveal no counterexample or boundary gap.
